scenes.text: You will never guess what this lump of dirt costs.
Course two begins at night, in an Italian forest near Alba. Hunters rely on trained dogs to sniff out the white truffle, hidden among tree roots.
Nobody has ever farmed it reliably. This ugly lump of dirt can cost more than gold, and its aroma fades within days.
Did you already know? One giant white truffle once sold for over three hundred thousand dollars.
Genius or scam? Drop your take below.
